title: Horror Caught On CCTV: Monitor Mercilessly Beats 5-Year-Old Nursery Kid For 12 Straight Minutes As Teacher Leaves Classroom Unattended In UP
description: A horrific case of abuse in classroom has surfaced from a private school in Lucknow where a class monitor mercilessly thrashed a five-year-old nursery kid for 12 straight minutes. The act was caught on the CCTV installed in the classroom.
